mutations.name: continue-after-first-failure
mutations.needle:
match m.abort with
  | some _ => m
  | none =>
mutations.replacement:
match (none : Option (AbortReason P A D)) with
  | some _ => m
  | none =>

mutations.name: publish-aborted-outputs
mutations.replacement: | .aborted label schedule _ m => [diagnosticEvent label schedule m]

mutations.name: stale-entry-world
mutations.needle: let next := Interleaving.advance cfg boundaries left right m.speculative branch
mutations.replacement:
let next := Interleaving.advance cfg boundaries left right
      { m.speculative with world := m.entryWorld } branch

mutations.name: peer-history-leakage
mutations.needle: let next := Interleaving.advance cfg boundaries left right m.speculative branch
mutations.replacement:
let peer := match branch with | .left => BranchId.right | .right => BranchId.left
    let own := m.speculative.local branch
    let leaky := m.speculative.setLocal branch
      { own with outputs := own.outputs ++ (m.speculative.local peer).outputs }
    let next := Interleaving.advance cfg boundaries left right leaky branch

mutations.name: global-boundary-index
mutations.needle: let next := Interleaving.advance cfg boundaries left right m.speculative branch
mutations.replacement:
let next := Interleaving.advance cfg (fun b _ ↦ boundaries b m.position)
      left right m.speculative branch

mutations.name: erase-debt-without-receipt
mutations.needle: owed lane p - receiptEffect receipt lane.cell else owed lane p
mutations.replacement:
(if receiptEffect receipt lane.cell = 0 then 0
      else owed lane p - receiptEffect receipt lane.cell) else owed lane p

mutations.name: opposite-vault-effect-sign
mutations.needle: owed lane p - receiptEffect receipt lane.cell else owed lane p
mutations.replacement: owed lane p + receiptEffect receipt lane.cell else owed lane p

mutations.name: global-settlement-sum
mutations.needle: policy.lanes.flatMap fun lane ↦ policy.participants.filterMap fun principal ↦
mutations.replacement:
if (policy.lanes.flatMap fun lane ↦
      policy.participants.map fun principal ↦ owed lane principal).sum = 0 then []
  else policy.lanes.flatMap fun lane ↦ policy.participants.filterMap fun principal ↦

mutations.name: collapse-principal-keys
mutations.needle: fun lane p ↦ if lane ∈ policy.lanes ∧ p = principal then
mutations.replacement: fun lane p ↦ if lane ∈ policy.lanes ∧ True then

mutations.name: collapse-asset-domain-keys
mutations.needle: owed lane p - receiptEffect receipt lane.cell else owed lane p
mutations.replacement:
owed lane p - (policy.lanes.map
      (fun candidate ↦ receiptEffect receipt candidate.cell)).sum else owed lane p

mutations.name: omit-final-lane
mutations.needle:
policy.lanes.flatMap fun lane ↦ policy.participants.filterMap fun principal ↦
    if owed lane principal = 0 then none else some ⟨lane, principal, owed lane principal⟩
mutations.replacement:
(policy.lanes.take (policy.lanes.length - 1)).flatMap fun lane ↦
    policy.participants.filterMap fun principal ↦
      if owed lane principal = 0 then none else some ⟨lane, principal, owed lane principal⟩

mutations.name: omit-final-participant
mutations.needle:
policy.lanes.flatMap fun lane ↦ policy.participants.filterMap fun principal ↦
    if owed lane principal = 0 then none else some ⟨lane, principal, owed lane principal⟩
mutations.replacement:
policy.lanes.flatMap fun lane ↦
    (policy.participants.take (policy.participants.length - 1)).filterMap fun principal ↦
      if owed lane principal = 0 then none else some ⟨lane, principal, owed lane principal⟩

mutations.name: accept-lane-supply
mutations.replacement: match (none : Option (Lane P A D × ℚ)) with

mutations.name: resurrect-revoked-grants
mutations.needle: let next := Interleaving.advance cfg boundaries left right m.speculative branch

mutations.name: omit-abort-reason
mutations.needle:
def observationEq (left right : Observation P A D) : Bool :=
  decide (left.label = right.label) && decide (left.schedule = right.schedule) &&
    decide (left.outcome = right.outcome) && worldEq left.world right.world &&
    decide (left.events = right.events) && decide (∀ d a, left.supply d a = right.supply d a)
mutations.replacement:
def observationEq (left right : Observation P A D) : Bool :=
  let normalize : Outcome P A D → Outcome P A D := fun outcome ↦
    match outcome with
    | .aborted (.kernel branch index position invocation _) =>
      .aborted (.kernel branch index position invocation .configuration)
    | other => other
  decide (left.label = right.label) && decide (left.schedule = right.schedule) &&
    decide (normalize left.outcome = normalize right.outcome) && worldEq left.world right.world &&
    decide (left.events = right.events) && decide (∀ d a, left.supply d a = right.supply d a)

mutations.name: omit-residual-amount
mutations.needle:
def observationEq (left right : Observation P A D) : Bool :=
  decide (left.label = right.label) && decide (left.schedule = right.schedule) &&
    decide (left.outcome = right.outcome) && worldEq left.world right.world &&
    decide (left.events = right.events) && decide (∀ d a, left.supply d a = right.supply d a)
mutations.replacement:
def observationEq (left right : Observation P A D) : Bool :=
  let normalize : Outcome P A D → Outcome P A D := fun outcome ↦
    match outcome with
    | .aborted (.unsettled remaining) =>
      .aborted (.unsettled (remaining.map fun residual ↦ { residual with amount := 0 }))
    | other => other
  decide (left.label = right.label) && decide (left.schedule = right.schedule) &&
    decide (normalize left.outcome = normalize right.outcome) && worldEq left.world right.world &&
    decide (left.events = right.events) && decide (∀ d a, left.supply d a = right.supply d a)
